canonical_operation.verification: rendered source-equivalent navigation is tenant-derived and remains inside the authorized content workspace

source_behavior.summary: The current global WordPress Comments workspace exposes a visible Content hub action in its toolbar that navigates to /content.
source_behavior.wordpress_behavior: none; activating this canonical control does not read from or mutate WordPress
source_behavior.connector_behavior: none; no Connector action is invoked
source_behavior.success_semantics: browser navigation only; the control emits no synthetic success message or mutation receipt

laravel_adaptation.runtime_wiring: CommentsContentHubLink renders only for the existing React comments RouteElement and fails closed without content.view
laravel_adaptation.target_runtime: existing React content-hub workspace under the authenticated tenant shell

runtime_path: auth + tenant.context resolve the active membership for /tenants/{tenant}/module/comments
CanonicalWorkspaceRouteController authorizes content.view and binds only a tenant-owned active Site
FrontendContext is reread for the same active tenant and publishes its tenant slug and content.view permission
React renders CommentsContentHubLink only on route.key=comments
the control derives /tenants/{activeTenant}/content exclusively through tenantUrl(context.tenant.slug, '/content')
navigation performs no API mutation, queue/cache/scheduler operation, provider call, Connector call, or WordPress call

authorization_and_isolation.missing_content_view_source: 403 and the frontend control independently renders nothing without content.view
authorization_and_isolation.foreign_site_source: 404 because showSiteBound resolves the selected Site through the active tenant global scope
authorization_and_isolation.tenant_path_encoding: tenantUrl URL-encodes the authoritative tenant slug so path fragments cannot synthesize another tenant
authorization_and_isolation.direct_id_surface: none; this control accepts no tenant, site, comment, user, or other resource identifier
authorization_and_isolation.csrf: not applicable because the canonical operation is a GET/navigation-only control

runtime_semantics.idempotency: repeated navigation has no persistent side effect
runtime_semantics.retry_safety: navigation may be repeated without creating jobs, writes, provider requests, or WordPress operations
runtime_semantics.authoritative_persistence_reread: not applicable to navigation-only operation; source tenant/site context is resolved authoritatively before rendering
runtime_semantics.secret_non_exposure: the component consumes only tenant slug and permission names and renders no connector/provider/WordPress secret
runtime_semantics.audit_or_receipt: not applicable because no mutation occurs

validated: guest redirect, missing-permission 403, foreign-tenant 404, and foreign-site 404
comments-only runtime wiring and no network/mutation hook
exact canonical marker and tenant-qualified content destination
permission fail-closed rendering and tenant-slug path encoding

canonical_denominator.note: Counts are expectations for the official generator guard only and are not manually written into canonical reconciliation.
